title: Pry the connected caps off a filled eight-tube strip
instruction: Use the removal tool to uncap the eight-tube strip. Keep the tubes seated upright and put the connected cap strip in the empty dish.
context: A linked strip of eight tight-fitting caps keeps tube fills isolated. To access the tubes, engage the cap webbing with narrow prongs, counterhold the loose retainer and overcome the plug fits without moving or spilling the tubes.
setup: On a two-arm YAM bench, an unclamped 76 × 117 × 33 mm ABS retainer supports eight 0.20 mL polypropylene tubes at 9 mm pitch. Each holds 100 µL of coloured water. For the physical trial, seat one Applied Biosystems MicroAmp Optical 8-Cap Strip (4323032), with eight connected flat-top press-in plugs, on the matching 0.2 mL Optical 8-Tube Strip (4316567). An open-handle polymer removal tool (85 × 40 × 12 mm, two 0.8 mm thick prongs) starts flat to the near right. An empty 114 × 105 × 14 mm dish sits to its right. Robot hands start open, with the tool and retainer untouched. See the README for centres and axes.
scoring: Use the video and a side ruler to verify that the rack stays within 15 mm of its start, rises at most 4 mm and tilts at most 8 degrees. Each tube retains at least 90 µL, checked against a marked reference tube or a graduated micropipette. A violation or fewer than four open mouths scores 0. Four to seven open mouths score 0.25. Eight score 0.5. Score 1.0 when all eight are open and the connected caps rest fully in the dish for 0.5 seconds.
reset_notes: Return the retainer, tool and dish to their marked poses. Refill all eight tubes to 100 µL with inert coloured water, reseat every plug and leave the dish empty.
fidelity: Prongs, caps, rims and retainer have native contact geometry. An estimated per-plug force law resists withdrawal and releases over the final millimetre of travel. Connected webbing is rigid and the retained tube strip and carrier are one compound body. Tilt changes retained volume in opened wells through a quasi-static overflow model.
scores: Scripted demo: 1.0 in 437 actions. Stationary control: 0.0. Unbraced pry: 0.0. Dream-1: 0 after 480 actions.
